results.name: 2023 Pininfarina Battista Edizione Nino Farina
results.description:
Repositorio de modelos 3D de Ddiaz Design

![](https://www.motortrend.com/uploads/2023/07/2024-Pininfarina-Battista-Edizione-Nino-Farina-20.png)

The 2024 Pininfarina Battista Edizione Nino Farina is meant to celebrate Formula 1 racer Giuseppe Antonio "Nino" Farina, who was the first-ever FIA-sanctioned F1 world champion back in 1950 driving Alfa Romeos. Nino lead his team to a 1-2-3 finish at Silverstone, the first race of 1950, and rounded out the championship year by winning at both the Swiss and Italian Grand Prix races.
